source.title: International Assistance Programs section (Table-5 OVER-CAP sub-split, page 19), unit 1 of 2: the two clean multi-line subtotal bureaus -- International Security Assistance and Agency for International Development. Each rolls its lines into its own Total--. The sibling unit -international-assistance-departmental holds Multilateral Assistance, the department-direct lines, the re-anchored ISA/AID totals, and Total--International Assistance Programs. Sizing: plans/treasury-mts-2026-05-outlays-table5.md (Int'l Assistance 165 cells -> 2 units, spans p19->20).
source.period: May FY2026 (This Month = May 2026; Current FYTD = Oct 2025 - May 2026; Prior FYTD = Oct 2024 - May 2025)

unit_note: USD millions ('[$ millions]' per table header). Table 5 legend (p. 23): '......' = 'No Transactions' (omitted); '(**)' = 'Less than absolute value of $500,000' (omitted). First of two units splitting the over-cap International Assistance Programs section; holds the two subtotal-bearing bureaus with multiple substantive lines. Values as printed, thousands separators stripped, negatives as leading '-'. Nine-column model. In each bureau only the 'Proprietary Receipts from the Public' line carries an Applicable value in most columns (single-source), so those line-level applicable cells are 'standalone' and the bureau-total applicable cells are leaf, covered by the bureau total-row net identity (the -state / -education-departmental pattern). Exception: International Security Assistance CFYTD applicable has two sources (its 'Other' line carries 7, Proprietary 43), so it rolls up; the ISA 'Other' line's own net identity covers its CFYTD/PFYTD applicable. Non-default tolerances quote the Table-5 rounding note (p. 23): 'Note: Details may not add to totals due to rounding.'
